rule.title: Automated Formatting and Style Guides as Common Law
rule.statement: Code formatting must be entirely delegated to automated deterministic tools (Prettier, ESLint). Style debates must never take place in manual code reviews.
rule.rationale: Human code reviewers wasting time discussing tabs, spaces, semicolons, and trailing commas burns cognitive energy that should be focused on architectural correctness and security.
rule.implementation_guidance: Enforce prettier --check and eslint in CI. Reject PRs with unformatted code automatically.

forbidden.example: A code review comment: 'Please add a newline between line 14 and 15.'

preferred.example: Configuring .prettierrc with singleQuote: true, trailingComma: 'all', and running pre-commit auto-formatting.

source.evidence_quote: The goal of a style guide is to produce consistency across the codebase. Enforce rules automatically using formatters and linters so humans can focus on design.
